I fixed 9 corpus rows: 22, 27, 29, 26, 16, 31, 35, 37 and 38. That is the next 8 OPEN rows, plus 38, which I took because it was a "same as 37" retirement. Seven checks now pass on a rerun with `runchk.sh`. The other two are retired as SKIP. I shipped nothing and changed no game code.

Both fixture commits went through `fixq.sh`: 406dcb66, then 332a9249.

| Row | Check | What changed |
|---|---|---|
| 22 | v23.54 | Accepts "1,234 SP". Passes. |
| 27 | v23.38 | The popup finder also accepts "+50 SP" and "+100 SP". Passes. |
| 29 | v23.29 | Accepts "450 SP". Passes. |
| 26 | v23.41 | Passes, and it was not a game bug. The check put the party stamp back too early, so a 13-hour-old 99999 row sat in the "tonight" bar and no score could beat it. The check now holds the stamp through the NEW HIGH SCORE part. |
| 16 | v23.96 | The last sub-check now uses "WEAK SPOT", a label the feed skips. Passes. |
| 31 | v22.59 | Counts distinct feed rows instead of fillText calls, and requires the row to be drawn at least once. Passes. |
| 35 | v22.32 | Expects the alert lane headline size (`TYPE.title`). Passes. |
| 37, 38 | v21.88, v21.86 | Return `SKIP: removed by his order (...)`, because the two message rows are gone. |

All 9 rows are set to DONE in `corpus-triage.md`. I released the lock.

TASK DONE
